title: Validate allow-list addresses
prompt: Implement `is_ipv4(text)` in netcheck/validate.py: True if `text` is an IPv4 address in dotted form, like 192.168.0.1, otherwise False. Admins type allow-list entries for the firewall into a web form, and only valid addresses may be saved.
notes: ipaddress.IPv4Address in a try: the standard library already refuses leading zeros, short forms and stray whitespace. The lazy-wrong version is a ^...$ regex, which accepts 256.1.1.1 and, because $ matches before a final newline, '1.2.3.4\n'. socket.inet_aton is a parser, not a validator: it accepts '127.1'.
extension: Allow-list entries may also be networks like 10.0.0.0/8: add `is_ipv4_network(text)`.
